# Tables

Simple table:

| Name | Value |
| ---- | ----- |
| alpha | 1 |
| beta | 2 |

Aligned table:

| Left | Center | Right |
| :--- | :----: | ----: |
| a | b | c |
| long cell | x | 42 |

Wide table that must shrink:

| short | a very long column header | another one that is long |
| ----- | ------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| 1 | wide content goes here and wraps | more content |
